reasoning_for_verdict: The leaf is non-numeric. Nothing in the cached wiki text or in a quoted formula can produce a {disposition, view_tag} map, so a positive independent derivation is impossible under this runbook.
No admissible source contradicts the new value either: the map's domain and vocabulary simply do not exist in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.
'old_value_correct' would assert that the leaf must remain absent — i.e. that emitting this observability map is itself an error. No admissible source supports that claim.

'both_wrong' would require showing the map's contents are wrong. The only substantive cardinality test available (step 4) failed to reproduce 178 under the documented item-availability rule, but the map's domain is unstated, so this is not a falsification.

Given the forced three-way enum, 'new_value_correct' is the least-unsupported call: an additive, non-numeric field appearing in a re-captured golden baseline is the expected consequence of an emitting feature, and no evidence contradicts it.
flags_for_the_parent_agent: This leaf is UNVERIFIABLE by the oracle protocol. Do not read this receipt as numeric corroboration — treat the verdict as 'not contradicted', and get the 178 entries reviewed against the emitting code by a reviewer who is allowed to read src/.

The 178-entry cardinality is not attested anywhere in the cached source data, and the closest principled item pool under CLAUDE.md rule 6 is 188 (SR-legal + purchasable + no champion restriction + no acquisition note), or 177 once champion restriction is applied to the nearest 178-sized fit. If 'dispositions' is meant to range over items, that mismatch is worth an explicit explanation.

Aside (off-task): docs/math-foundations.md Section 3.1 asserts |L| = 116 eligible legendary items 'in the current cache', but the current data/items.json yields 117 LEGENDARY SR-legal items (118 tier-3 SR-legal). Adding a large non-numeric observability map to the golden baseline weakens the gate's stated semantics (CLAUDE.md: 'a pure refactor must show zero diffs'), since UI-facing view tags will now churn the numeric-regression diff. Worth a design call on whether dispositions belong in the golden snapshot or in a separate receipt.
